caption:
5 signs an AI-written reply needs a human before you send it

I asked for a reply to a complaint with a vague prompt. The draft sounded fine, until I read it properly:

1) A bracket was still in it: [Customer Name].
2) It promised "this won't happen again" and a refund nobody had decided on.
3) It said "we're looking into what happened". Nobody was.
4) No name, no order number: it could have gone to anyone.
5) Late order plus ignored emails: high stakes, so a human writes the last version.

The fix is one more prompt with the real facts:

"Rewrite this reply. Use only these facts: [WHAT HAPPENED, WHAT I'VE DONE, WHAT I'LL DO]. No promises beyond those. Use their name and order number. Under 80 words. Draft: [PASTE]"

Follow @nomorebusywork and comment PACK: I'll DM you 21 more prompts.

Save this for later. 📌
